title: 把符号组成词
Words in generators and inverses
text: 从生成符号及其形式逆符号拼出有限词。空词代表单位元；相邻的 xx⁻¹ 或 x⁻¹x 可以消去。此节为拓展阅读。
Build finite words from generators and their formal inverses. The empty word is the identity; adjacent inverse pairs cancel. This section is optional reading.
example: ab b⁻¹a⁻¹ 消去为空词，但 aba⁻¹b⁻¹ 不能消去；非交换性体现在不能擅自交换字母。
abb⁻¹a⁻¹ reduces to the empty word, whereas aba⁻¹b⁻¹ does not. Letters cannot be freely commuted.

title: 约化词与唯一性
Reduced words and uniqueness
text: 不含相邻逆符号的词叫约化词。可用栈逐字读取：新字母若与栈顶互逆就弹出，否则入栈。结果不依赖消去顺序。
A reduced word has no adjacent inverse pair. A stack reads letters left to right, canceling inverse neighbors. The final reduced word is independent of cancellation order.
proof: 每次消去都使长度减少 2，因此消去过程一定停止。
Each cancellation decreases length by two, so the process terminates.
两个可消去对若不重叠，消去次序互不影响；若重叠，局部只能是 xx⁻¹x 或 x⁻¹xx⁻¹，两种选择都留下同一个字母。
Disjoint cancellations commute. Overlapping cancellations occur only in xx⁻¹x or x⁻¹xx⁻¹ and give the same result.
对词长归纳：比较两条消去路径的第一步，利用上面的局部相容性合到同一个较短词，再用归纳，得到相同最终约化词。
Induct on word length. The first two cancellation choices can be joined at a shorter word; induction then gives the same reduced form.

title: 自由群的运算
The free-group operation
text: 所有约化词在“拼接后约化”的运算下构成自由群 F(S)。自由指除了群公理迫使的消去外，不加入额外关系。
Reduced words form F(S) under concatenation followed by reduction. Freeness means there are no additional relations beyond cancellations forced by the group axioms.
proof: 唯一约化性给出 red(red(uv)w)=red(uvw)=red(u red(vw))，因此结合律成立。
Unique reduction gives red(red(uv)w)=red(uvw)=red(u red(vw)), proving associativity.
空词是双侧单位元；词倒序逐字取逆后，与原词拼接可全部消去，得到双侧逆元。
The empty word is a two-sided identity. Reversing and inverting every letter gives a two-sided inverse.

title: 自由群的泛性质
The universal property
text: 任意指定生成符号在群 G 中的像，都唯一延伸为 F(S) 到 G 的同态。只要给出生成元的像，词的像就被迫确定。
Every assignment of generators to elements of a group extends uniquely to a homomorphism from the free group.
proof: 把词 x₁…xₖ 送到对应像的乘积；形式逆符号送到相应逆元。
Evaluate each word as the product of assigned images, sending inverse symbols to inverses.
消去相邻逆符号不改变乘积，所以约化不改变结果，且拼接对应乘法。得到同态。
Canceling adjacent inverse symbols does not change the product; concatenation becomes multiplication.
任何延伸 f 的同态都必须按此公式作用于每个词，因此唯一。
Any homomorphism extending f must evaluate words this way, giving uniqueness.

title: 生成元与关系
Generators and relations
text: 把关系词强制变为单位元，需要商掉它们生成的最小正规子群，称为正规闭包。只商掉普通生成子群未必可行。
To force relator words to become identities, quotient by their normal closure, the smallest normal subgroup containing them. An ordinary generated subgroup may not be normal.
example: Cₙ=⟨a∣aⁿ=e⟩；Dₙ=⟨r,s∣rⁿ=s²=e, srs=r⁻¹⟩。等式 u=v 对应关系词 uv⁻¹=e。
Examples: Cₙ=⟨a∣aⁿ=e⟩ and Dₙ=⟨r,s∣rⁿ=s²=e, srs=r⁻¹⟩. An equation u=v corresponds to the relator uv⁻¹.

title: 关系式为什么恰好定义 Dₙ
Why the presentation gives exactly Dₙ
text: 验证一组几何变换满足关系，只能得到一个满射；还要证明关系没有留下额外元素，才能完成同构证明。
Checking relations in a geometric group gives a surjection. To prove an isomorphism, also show the presentation leaves no extra elements.
proof: 由 sr=r⁻¹s 可把每个 s 移到词的右端；rⁿ=e、s²=e 将词约成 rᵏsᵉ，0≤k<n、e∈{0,1}。所以所表达的群至多有 2n 个元素。
Move every s to the right and reduce exponents. Every word becomes rᵏsᵉ, giving at most 2n elements.
正 n 边形的旋转与反射满足这些关系并生成 Dₙ，因此存在到 Dₙ 的满同态。
Geometric rotation and reflection satisfy the relations and generate Dₙ, giving a surjection.
Dₙ 确有 2n 个元素，所以源群至少有 2n 个；上、下界相同，满射于是为同构。
Dₙ has 2n elements, so the upper bound is attained and the surjection is an isomorphism.

question: 自由群中 ab b⁻¹a⁻¹ 的约化结果是？
Reduce abb⁻¹a⁻¹ in the free group.
reason: 先消去 bb⁻¹，再消去 aa⁻¹，得到空词。

question: 自由群中 (ab)⁻¹ 是？
What is (ab)⁻¹ in the free group?
reason: 乘积取逆要倒序，再逐项取逆。
Reverse the order and invert each factor.

question: 添加关系 R 时，要商掉哪个子群？
Which subgroup must be quotiented out to impose relators R?
options: The ordinary subgroup generated by R
reason: 关系必须在共轭下也成立；正规闭包才保证商群有定义。
Relators must remain trivial under conjugation; normal closure makes the quotient well-defined.

question: 一个生成元的自由群同构于？
The free group on one generator is isomorphic to?
reason: 只有 aᵏ（k∈ℤ），且没有非零幂等于单位元的额外关系。
Its reduced words are aᵏ for integers k, with no nonzero power forced to be the identity.

question: 为什么证明某些变换满足给定关系，还不能直接断言它们就是这个表达所定义的群？
Why does checking relations in a target group not yet prove that the presentation defines that group?
reason: 检查关系只能诱导到目标生成群的满同态，其核仍可能非平凡。还需证明单射，例如先用关系式给出标准形与阶的上界，再和目标群的阶比较。
Checking relations induces a surjective homomorphism onto the generated target; its kernel could be nontrivial. Prove injectivity, for example via normal forms and matching order bounds.

Supplementary example · Dihedral presentation
